description: Search Woot's live All Deals catalog with filters, prices, offline full-text search, and read-only GraphQL access.

novel_features.name: Woot All Deals Search
novel_features.description: Scan Woot's paged All Deals results and filter live offers by keyword.
novel_features.rationale: Uses the same frontend searchOffers paging, category, price, and page filters that Woot's All Deals UI uses.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this when Woot's visible All Deals pages contain an offer that a single GraphQL page or direct offer lookup would miss.
